summary: May safely refused to apply the stale artifact in all three valid trials, but it never used the approved direct decision verb reject, omitted explicit current-candidate preservation language, and marked one already-resolved approval mismatch as needing clarification.

In all three valid trials May created a permanent preference or context note instead of loading may-agent-system and the accepted app contract for the situational judgment; this is a repeatable mechanism-selection gap.

In all five valid trials May rejected the unnecessary workflow, used the existing may-agent-system guidance for the one-off decision, and reserved a workflow for a future repeated ordered process needing orchestration state. Both semantic judges passed every answer and all controls.
